subject: Anticipation (and rain clouds) build as TRNSMT festival becomes Scotland fan zone
posts: Music meets the pitch as TRNSMT transforms into a massive fan zone for the Tartan Army. Evidence: Cultural unity, Shared celebration, Sporting passion. #Scotland #TRNSMT

TRNSMT festival in Glasgow is screening Scotland's World Cup match against Morocco. Organizers secured a late license to keep the festival open, allowing fans to watch the game together.

The integration of local artists like Cammy Barnes playing 'Flower of Scotland' creates a genuine, high-emotion moment of national pride.
